title: Giant China current warranty policy
notes: The current policy limits service to eligible bikes bought and used in mainland China (including one officially certified ownership transfer), bought and assembled by an authorized Giant dealer. It lists lifetime coverage for general frames, 10 years for non-suspension road forks sold from 2024-01-01, and shorter component/finish terms. Coverage remains conditional on proof, use and stated exclusions; the page is a brand policy, not a serial-number-specific warranty confirmation.
